Key Takeaways
The meeting outlined a structured agenda, starting with discussions on web portal and marketing tech, followed by tech delivery, and concluding with SEO product updates.
There was a focus on improving the precision of Google Custom Search API outputs, with plans to explore using image alt tags and other APIs to enhance results.
The team discussed the need for multilingual support for game data, with plans to implement language-specific content and ensure games are tailored to user language preferences.
A strategy was proposed to manage user authentication for games accessed via web view, including the use of temporary game IDs to track user progress and recommendations.
The meeting concluded with a plan to push code updates regularly, ensuring that any work done is documented and shared with the team for review and feedback.
